def clean_and_tokenize(text):
    # Normalize: lowercase, remove special chars keeping alphanumerics
    text = str(text).lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^\w\s]", " ", text)
    tokens = text.split()
    return tokens

UNK_IDX = len(word_to_idx)
PAD_IDX = UNK_IDX + 1


def encode_text(tokens, max_len):
    encoded = [word_to_idx.get(token, PAD_IDX) for token in tokens]
    # Pad to max_len
    actual_len = len(encoded)
    if actual_len < max_len:
        encoded += [PAD_IDX] * (max_len - actual_len)
    return encoded


MAX_SEQ_LEN = 64  # Reduced for speed and memory


# --- Dataset ---
class TextClassificationDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, ids, texts, labels, tokenizer, max_len):
        self.ids = ids
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_len = max_len

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.ids)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        encoded = encode_text(self.texts[idx], self.max_len)
        label_vector = np.zeros(6, dtype=np.float32)
        label_vector = label_vector.astype(torch.float32)
        # Map toxicity names to indices
        toxicity_order = [
            "toxic",
            "severe_toxic",
            "obscene",
            "threat",
            "insult",
            "identity_hate",
        ]

        # Assuming columns match toxicity names directly

        for i, col_name in enumerate(toxicity_order):
            if col_name in self.labels.columns:
                label_vector[i] = self.labels[col_name].iloc[idx]
            else:
                label_vector[i] = 0.0  # Fallback
        return torch.tensor(encoded, dtype=torch.long), torch.tensor(
            label_vector, dtype=torch.float32
        )


# --- Model ---
class ToxicModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        embed_dim=64,
        num_layers=1,
        hidden_dim=256,
        vocab_size=vocab_size,
        num_classes=6,
        dropout=0.5,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.embedding = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, embed_dim, padding_idx=PAD_IDX)
        self.lstm = nn.LSTM(
            embed_dim,
            hidden_dim,
            num_layers=num_layers,
            bidirectional=True,
            dropout=dropout if num_layers > 1 else 0,
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.fc = nn.Linear(hidden_dim * 2, num_classes)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()

    def forward(self, x):
        # x: [B, L]
        emb = self.dropout(self.embedding(x))  # [B, L, D]
        lstm_out, _ = self.lstm(emb)  # [B, L, H*2]
        concat = lstm_out[:, -1, :]  # Take last layer feature
        pooled = self.dropout(concat)
        out = self.fc(pooled)  # [B, C]
        return out
